# Syria OpenSourceRail Campaign
<!-- Generated by scripts/generate-marketing-campaigns.py. -->

National outreach package covering **9 catalogued cities**. Values
below aggregate city screening models; the national brief separately treats the
shared manufacturing plant.

## Audience

- Syria ministry responsible for transport and urban mobility
- Syria national climate, energy or Green Climate Fund authority
- Syria public investment, planning or finance authority
- Embassy or High Commission of Syria in the United Kingdom — economic section

## National proposition

| Measure | Catalogue result |
|---|---:|
| Population represented | 7,617,000 |
| Lines / route length | 33 / 676 km |
| Fleet | 1,124 trainsets |
| City programme CAPEX | $5.68 B |
| Local capital and value allocation | $4.34 B (76%) |
| Station/depot PV / storage | 111.3 MW / 588.5 MWh |
| Illustrative external-capital saving | $8.89 B |

Lead with a government-reviewed pilot, local manufacturing and construction,
open standards, renewable-energy integration and independently checked demand,
environmental, social and engineering studies.
